branding.tagline: Live, validated MYOB reports that refresh each time you open them.

description: Live MYOB reports for your Reports library, including profit and loss, balance sheet, trial balance, general ledger, aged receivables and payables, GST and BAS, budgets, payroll, inventory, jobs, dashboards and report packs. Each report reads your connected MYOB company file every time it opens, checks its own figures and shows the result. You can download it as PDF or Excel, or share it. Find the reports in Reports, under From your plugins. Read-only in MYOB.
name: myob-reporting-studio
